name: Lindhaus
legalEntityNote: Lindhaus S.r.l. is the Italian company named in official product documents and website materials. The official history describes a family business and separately identifies Rotafil as the family company's electric-motor manufacturer; distributors, importers, contracting sellers and warranty providers remain separate roles.
headline: Lindhaus Italian cleaning machines, production and buyer checks
description: A source-backed profile of Lindhaus S.r.l., its family-business identity, Italian professional and domestic cleaning portfolio, manufacturing statements, international channels and procurement checks.
metaDescription: Lindhaus profile: family business, Italian production, scrubber dryers, vacuums, sweepers, domestic floorcare, channels and buyer checks.
disclaimer: World Clean Biz is an independent industry publication and is not affiliated with Lindhaus. Company-level Made in Italy and supply-chain statements do not prove the origin, configuration, seller or warranty terms of every model and component.

ownership.summary: Lindhaus's official company history describes it as a family business and says a new generation works with the longstanding team. The reviewed official sources do not disclose current shareholders, share percentages or a parent company, so this page does not infer current ownership from that family-business identity. Rotafil is identified as the family company's electric-motor manufacturer and should not be presented as a distributor or as proof of every model's component origin.

productPortfolio.name: Professional vacuums and upright cleaners
productPortfolio.positioning: Corded and cordless upright, canister and backpack vacuums form a central part of the professional indoor-cleaning range.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Confirm filtration, airflow, brush head, battery or voltage, noise, accessories, consumables and commercial-use warranty.

productPortfolio.name: Scrubber dryers and floor washers
productPortfolio.positioning: Compact scrubber dryers and floor washers target hard-floor cleaning in professional and domestic settings.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Compare brush system, tanks, edge reach, drying, battery, realistic runtime, floor compatibility and maintenance access.

productPortfolio.name: Sweepers and carpet-cleaning equipment
productPortfolio.positioning: Sweepers, carpet cleaners and electric brush systems extend the offer across textile and hard-floor applications.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Validate debris and carpet types, cleaning path, extraction result, filtration, consumables and local parts availability.

productPortfolio.name: Domestic floorcare and health products
productPortfolio.positioning: Lindhaus also markets domestic vacuums, upright cleaners, floor washers and selected air or surface-care products.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Separate domestic and professional duty ratings, certifications, warranty terms and channel support when building an assortment.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Lindhaus says all of its machines are designed and manufactured in Italy and that it directly controls product development and quality.
manufacturingSupplyChain.scope: Company-level statement across the published range; it does not disclose the origin of every component
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Request the exact model's legal manufacturer, production site, serial plate, country of origin and conformity documentation.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: The official 2026 full-line brochure dates Lindhaus to 1987 and describes total supply-chain control, while identifying Rotafil as the family company's electric-motor manufacturer.
manufacturingSupplyChain.scope: Official company history and supply-chain positioning; motor and component fit still vary by model
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Ask which motor, battery, electronics, pump and other major assemblies are used in the contracted SKU and who supplies them.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: The company describes in-house design, functional and safety testing, component selection and durability verification.
manufacturingSupplyChain.scope: Published development and quality process rather than a model-specific inspection record
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Obtain the quoted model's test standards, certification reports, quality plan, change-control process and production-lot records.

marketsChannels.evidence: Lindhaus maintains international website editions and an official world-contact page, and its full-line brochure says the machines are sold worldwide.
marketsChannels.scope: Company-described international reach; active models, authorization and support vary by country
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Confirm the authorized distributor, importer, contracting seller, product authorization and service territory directly with Lindhaus.

marketsChannels.evidence: The official brochure identifies a U.S. office opened in Minneapolis in 1992 for domestic-machine distribution.
marketsChannels.scope: U.S. historical and channel context; it does not define current responsibilities in every North American transaction
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Verify the current U.S. contracting, inventory, warranty and service entities for the quoted product.

marketsChannels.evidence: Lindhaus publishes separate professional and domestic lines and invites prospective distributors through its official site.
marketsChannels.scope: Brand channel structure; professional and domestic warranty or duty terms should not be assumed equivalent
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Lock the applicable range, commercial-use warranty, parts stock, technician coverage, response time and escalation route.

competitivePosition.summary: World Clean Biz assessment: Lindhaus differentiates through specialised indoor floorcare, Italian production claims and an overlap between professional and domestic ranges. Buyers should verify exact-model origin, duty rating and destination-market service rather than generalising from the brand-wide Made in Italy message.

developments.title: Lindhaus opens a U.S. distribution office
developments.summary: The official 2026 full-line brochure says an office opened in Minneapolis in 1992 to distribute domestic machines in the U.S. market.

developments.title: Lindhaus is established
developments.summary: The official full-line brochure dates the birth of Lindhaus as a cleaning-machine designer and manufacturer to 1987.
